title: 3D osu! logo
description: A Minecraft resource pack that adds a 3D osu! logo model by renaming a stick to "osu" using CIT Resewn or OptiFine.
body: # 🎶 3D osu! This resource pack adds a **3D model of the osu! logo** into Minecraft by replacing the stick when renamed. It’s a fun little cosmetic addition for osu! fans who want to carry the circle with them everywhere! --- ## 🔧 How It Works - The pack uses **Custom Item Textures (CIT)** to swap the default stick model. - To see the custom model, you’ll need to **rename a stick to `osu`** in an anvil. - Once renamed, the stick will transform into a **3D osu! logo** in your hand and inventory. --- ## 📦 Requirements This pack requires one of the following mods to function: - **[cit resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) (Fabric) - **[Optifne](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) (Forge) Without one of these, the model will not appear correctly. --- ## ✨ Features - A clean, custom-made **3D osu! logo model**. - Lightweight and works alongside most other resource packs. - Only replaces sticks that are renamed to `osu`, so normal sticks remain unaffected. - Great for showing off in multiplayer servers with friends! --- ## 📥 Installation 1. Download the resource pack `.zip`. 2. Place it in your `resourcepacks` folder. 3. Enable the pack from Minecraft’s resource pack menu. 4. Make sure you’re using **CIT Resewn** or **OptiFine**. 5. Rename a stick to `osu` in an anvil. 6. Enjoy your shiny new osu! logo stick! 🎵 --- Carry the circle. Spread the rhythm. ✨
